narrative: A foul-paper sheet of the fifth act, the near corner cut clean away, the cut about the width of a groat. Fourteen lines stand above the cut. A grey cat is asleep on a thick printed book at the elbow. Your father's glover's paring-knife lies on the board. No face. One surface.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Cut the corner and left the fourteen lines as they stood.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
